name: kiro-apikey-ide
description: 使用 Kiro API Key（ksk_）直接在 Kiro 自带的对话框里选择模型聊天。

scripts.build:webview: cd webview-ui && npm install && npm run build:prod
scripts.package: npm run build:webview && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@latest package --out kiro-apikey-ide-$npm_package_version.vsix --allow-star-activation --skip-license --allow-missing-repository

kiroApikeyIde.enabled.description: Master switch. When on, Kiro's built-in AI calls are routed through your Kiro API key. When off, Kiro uses its official service unchanged.

kiroApikeyIde.apiKeys.description: Your Kiro API keys (each starts with ksk_). Requests always use the selected (active) key — no automatic rotation. Managed from the Control Panel.

kiroApikeyIde.activeApiKey.description: The currently selected API key used for connections (must be one of apiKeys). Falls back to the first key.

kiroApikeyIde.apiKey.description: Deprecated: legacy single API key. Auto-migrated into apiKeys.

kiroApikeyIde.region.description: The AWS region your Kiro API key belongs to. Default us-east-1. Change if your key was issued in another region (e.g. eu-central-1).

kiroApikeyIde.ports.description: Local proxy ports. krs = AI generation plane, cps = control plane (models/usage).
